newsitem.title: THAILAND: Six Asian countries, UN pledge to combat drugs.
newsitem.headline: Six Asian countries, UN pledge to combat drugs.

text.p: Senior officials of six Asian countries and the United Nations Drugs Control Programme (UNDCP) pledged on Friday to increase cooperation on drug control in the region.

The officials issued a statement pledging cooperation following a meeting of high ranking government officials of Cambodia, Laos, Vietnam, China, Burma, Thailand and a UNDCP official on ways to combat drugs in the region.

They also signed agreements for implementation of several drug control projects, including a project to increase and improve the exchange of intelligence between law enforcement agencies and a project to provide training for law enforcement officers in drug law enforcement skills, it said.

During the meeting, the second of its kind, officials reviewed progress of an action plan endorsed at the first meeting held in Beijing in 1995. The Golden Triangle, which straddles the borders of Laos, Thailand and Burma, is said by U.S. drug enforcement officials to supply about 70 percent of the world's heroin.
